raw.content_en: The US Department of Commerce (BIS) rescinded the Biden-era firearms rule, restoring prior export control treatment for civilian firearms, ammunition, and parts. For China-origin exporters and re-exporters shipping to or through the United States, this shifts licensing thresholds and classification practice for sporting and civilian firearms under ECCNs 0A501/0A502/0A504 and related USML-to-CML transfers. Exporters must re-verify ECCN classification, license exception eligibility (e.g., LVS, RPL), and end-user/end-use statements. Section 301 tariffs and HTS alignment still apply to many firearm parts and optics. Entity List and restricted party screening remains mandatory, and any dual-use or military end-use diversion is prohibited. Retain records for five years and align commercial invoices, AES filings, and destination control statements.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支出口规则，恢复对民用枪支、弹药及零部件的原有出口管制待遇。对于向美国出口或经美国转运的中国原产出口商和再出口商，此举改变了运动及民用枪支在ECCN 0A501/0A502/0A504项下的许可门槛和分类实践，并涉及USML向CML的转移。出口商须重新核实ECCN分类、许可例外资格（如LVS、RPL）以及最终用户/最终用途声明。Section 301关税及HTS归类仍适用于许多枪支部件和光学器件。实体清单及受限方筛查仍为强制要求，禁止任何两用或军事最终用途的转用。记录须保存五年，并确保商业发票、AES申报和目的地管制声明一致。

checklist.desc: Re-confirm ECCN 0A501/0A502/0A504 and USML Category I/II status for each firearm, part, and optic after the rule rescission; document classification rationale.
Assess LVS, RPL, and other license exception availability under the restored rules; verify dollar value limits and eligible destinations before shipment.
Run restricted party and Entity List screening on all US consignees and intermediaries; retain end-user and end-use statements for controlled items.
Map each firearm part and optic to the 10-digit HTS line, check Section 301 lists and additional duties, and document country of origin and value build-up.

checklist.task: AES filing and destination control statement
checklist.desc: File accurate AES/EEI data, apply the correct destination control statement on invoices, and keep records for five years.
For electronic sights, rangefinders, and wireless accessories, confirm FCC IDs and modular approvals before US entry.
